origins: I grew up in Encino, CA, and I have always been drawn to making things, whether that was sketching characters, building physical projects, or messing with digital tools. Creating has always felt like the most natural way for me to express myself. I get inspired by a lot of different things. Games, album art, street graphics, and bold visual storytelling all grab my attention. I like work that has personality, sharp lines, and color choices that actually mean something. My taste leans clean but playful. I like heavy black, bright accents, and fonts with quirks. I love when design feels intentional but still has room to breathe and experiment. I am also influenced by the idea of exploring options instead of locking into one idea too early. I like trying things, breaking things, and seeing what happens. That curiosity has shaped my approach more than any specific tool or discipline. At the end of the day, I just like creating things that feel unique, personal, and a little unexpected. If it tells a story or sparks a reaction, that is what matters to me.
